compartment.title: Completed and committed Batch 2 — KeyringProvider, registry, and config schema
compartment.p1:
Batch 2 was implemented across three segments (80-90, 91-111, 112-124) on `feature/phase-10-secret-injection`. The first two segments built the KeyringProvider interface, registry, and config schema and wrote tests. The final segment (112-124) fixed pre-commit lint violations and committed.
Pre-commit lint found issues in `loader.ts` (while-assignment pattern violating non-null assertion rules) and `registry.ts` (variable shadowing and missing `biome-ignore` comments). All violations were corrected. Final validation: type-check ✓, 65 tests ✓, lint ✓. Batch 2 committed on `feature/phase-10-secret-injection`.
Batch 2 files: - `src/provider/types.ts` — `KeyringProvider` interface, `ProviderCapabilities`, `ProviderHealth` - `src/provider/registry.ts` — `ProviderRegistry` — register, findForResource, resolve, listAll, getProvider, clear, with first-match-wins resolution - `src/provider/registry.test.ts` — 15 tests covering registration, resource resolution, provider fallback, error propagation, listAll with failure tolerance - `src/config/schema.ts` — Zod schema for `.agentsy/secrets.yaml` — `providers` keyed by id, `resourceTypes`, TTL overrides - `src/config/loader.ts` — 3-level config discovery (`.agentsy/secrets.yaml`, `./secrets.yaml`, `~/.config/agentsy/secrets.yaml`), YAML parsing via `yaml` - `src/provider/index.ts` — Barrel re-exports - `src/config/index.ts` — Barrel re-exports - `src/index.ts` — Re-exports provider + config types
Deps added: `zod ^3.24.5`, `yaml ^2.7.1`.
compartment.p2: Batch 2 (KeyringProvider interface + registry + config schema) completed and committed on `feature/phase-10-secret-injection`. Pre-commit lint fixes applied to loader.ts and registry.ts before final commit. Type-check ✓, 65 tests ✓, lint ✓.
compartment.p3: Batch 2 complete — KeyringProvider interface, ProviderRegistry, and YAML config schema implemented and committed on the Phase 10 branch.
